verdict.rationale: Disclosing what happens when automation or API limits are exceeded (overage charges, throttling, or a hard stop) is a fair question for a work-management SaaS with automations and a GraphQL API, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of limit-exceeded behavior. The only nearby item is an admin dashboard that tracks AI credit spend, which is an adjacent feature: it does not explain overage charges, throttling, or cutoffs.
